'''Darkside''' was a sector of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that was located in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|Coruscant underworld]].

==Description==
Darkside was located one [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometer]] beneath the upper levels of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], although it was between three and four kilometers above the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] surface. It was divided into four sectors: the [[Industrial Sector (Coruscant)|Industrial Sector]], the [[Recycling Sector]], the [[Residential Sector]], and the [[Services Sector]].

==History==
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] traveled to Darkside, following the [[destruction of the Almas Academy]]. He was tracked there by the [[Heroes of Cularin]], who attacked and defeated him.
